= Source callout guards
:source-highlighter: rouge

.Default guards are language-independent
[source,rust]
----
rust(); // <1>
python = 1 # <2>
SELECT 1; -- <3>
(def x 1) ;; <4>
<tag/> <!--5-->
single ; <6>
multiple(); // <7> <8>
----
<1> Slash guard
<2> Hash guard
<3> Dash guard
<4> Double-semicolon guard
<5> XML guard
<6> Single semicolon remains
<7> First marker on one line
<8> Second marker on one line

.Custom prefix is not a PDF guard
[source,rust,line-comment="%"]
----
custom(); % <1>
ordinary(); // <2>
----
<1> Custom prefix remains
<2> Standard guard is removed

.Escaped markers
[source,rust]
----
literal // \<1>
literal \<!--2-->
real // <1>
----
<1> Real callout
